notes.title: First Major Update
notes.content:
We are excited to release the first major update for D.C. S#*!storm! The update includes:

- Two new politicians; Mitt Romney (R) and Kristen Gillibrand (D)
- 12 Steam Achievements
- 42 new humorous sound bites
- Improved AI and difficulty scaling for Samson the Eagle
- Dozens of news headlines featuring new and updated current events

We are also offering a 25% discount to celebrate the update. Thanks for your support and go get those achievements!
